newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 31.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 31.

text.p: -- CIGNA Corp reported better-than-expected second quarter operating income of $270 million, or $3.61 per share, helped by strength in its employee retirement and savings benefits businesses. The earnings were up from $3.28 per share a year ago and surpassed the First Call consensus estimate of $3.44. The stock closed at 195-3/4.

-- JLG Industries Inc said its earnings per share for the fourth quarter ending July 31 would be below previous expectations and would fall short of the year-earlier $0.30 per share. It cited recent order softness and competitive market conditions. The company announced a restructuring under which it will cut its workforce by 850 employees, or 30 percent. The stock last traded at 12-3/8.

-- Alpharma Inc reported a second quarter profit of $0.16 per share versus a loss of $0.22 a year earlier. The company said it expected sales and earnings to accelerate in the second half. The stock last traded at 17-1/8.
-- A.H. Belo Corp reported second quarter earnings of $0.42 per share, down from $0.60 in the year-ago quarter. The stock closed at 45-1/4.
